Team,

Quick nudge as we head into forecast finalization for Q2: I pulled a short export of open opportunities where either Stage or Close Date looks stale (attached: opps_export_Q2.csv). Please do the following by EOD Monday so the FP&A rollup is accurate:

- Move any deals that are no longer active to Closed Lost (include a one-line reason).

- If you need to re-qualify the opportunity with the champion/prospect, add a Task and tag me / Marissa.

I'll aggregate responses and update the forecast sheet. This is a small set (20 rows) but it drives our revenue plan, so please prioritize.

Thanks — Ben
